svg.aria-label: Classic, layer-wise and multiplex NBS on one network measured at four time points or frequencies
svg.title: Classic, layer-wise and multiplex NBS on one network measured at four time points or frequencies
svg.text: Classic NBS tests the network at one time
point or frequency chosen in advance.
Edges above the threshold that share
and its size is compared with the largest
Layer-wise NBS runs classic NBS at every
time point or frequency. Each component
stays at its own point, and one permutation
correction covers all of them together.
Same region at the next point
Multiplex-NBS links a region to itself at the
next time point or frequency while it stays
active (dashed lines), so an effect that
persists forms one component and is tested
